lines: Don't make me call your shadow 'the worst'.
It's okay to be hurt, isn't it?
I'm sure I'll end up being rejected.
But I still love you. Is this longing too heavy?
With these five characters, 'Let's break up',
we grow more distant than strangers.
If only we hadn't met, I wouldn't have cried.
I stayed silent to you as you cried.
I couldn't even tell a lie; I just watched.
The person you were back then is gone; I already knew that.
The dissatisfactions that piled up
never disappeared, and I couldn't even tell you.
Even though you said, 'Don't keep secrets from me',
you hide things from me, don't you? Why?
The time I spent with you,
no one else can fill.
One-sided love is empty, isn't it?
No matter how I struggle, it's meaningless, and I must now put a lid on these feelings of longing for you.
I stayed silent to you as you cried.
I stood frozen, still not listening to your selfishness.
'It'll be alright,' irresponsible words
were all I could say.
I stayed silent to you as you cried.
I couldn't even tell a lie; I just watched.
The person I was back then is gone; I already knew that.
I already knew that.
